messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: runtime-serving:5xx-error-rate HIGH (2m window) — triggered by service-runtime-prod - alert_id=PD-4821
pagerduty: Escalation: page sent to on-call (primary) — please acknowledge within 3m
jamie: acked — i'm on it, pulling up traces and dashboards now :coffee:
jamie: quick peek — 5xx spike started ~30s ago, looks like a burst on a small subset of pods
sasha: any customer-facing errors reported? slack/screened alerts?
mike: no customer complaint tickets so far, Synthetics show one failed check at 12:03:21 UTC but recovered
devops-bot: logs snippet from last 2m:
```
[12:03:10] svc-runtime | ERROR | upstream timeout on model shard 12 conn=0x7f.. | trace_id=abc123
[12:03:12] svc-runtime | WARN  | retry attempt 1 for req /v1/generate
[12:03:14] svc-runtime | ERROR | kvcache miss + backend queue full
```
jamie: looks like a transient backend queue pressure on shard 12 — I can see dropped requests routed to fallback model which increased latency then some timeouts
sasha: is this limited to a single AZ/pool? can you attach pod ids?
jamie: pod ids: runtime-12a, runtime-12b showing higher cpu and queue depth. restarting runtime-12a now — will monitor
jamie: restart issued (kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-12a)
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by jamie :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Note: if not resolved in 5m, will escalate to secondary
mike: metrics updated — 5xx rate trending back down, error spike duration ~40s so far
pagerduty: Alert auto-resolved: runtime-serving:5xx-error-rate cleared after 52s — reason: condition no longer met
jamie: so it auto-resolved after restart + short backlog drain — looks like a noisy burst, not a config regression
sasha: good. customer impact: low. we had 12 failed requests across all tenants in that 52s window, no open support tickets. marking P2? maybe P3 cause auto-resolved quickly
mike: agree P3. still want follow-up to reduce noise and avoid pages for short spikes
jamie: suggested actions:
- create follow-up: ENGOPS-312 (postmortem + noise-tune)
- add 90s dedup window to the PD rule or require sustained > threshold across 3 points
- add per-shard queue alert and runbook to auto-scale or shed traffic earlier
sasha: also add a synthetic that hits model shard 12 to detect queue-pressure earlier
jamie: assigning follow-up to on-call rotation for next week, i'll file the ticket and hand off to @mike for next shift
mike: took note, i'll pick this up during handoff. also can add temporary mute for this alert to avoid repeated flapping overnight if it happens again
incident-bot: oncall-handoff: jamie handing off to mike for the 20:00 UTC -> 04:00 UTC window
jamie: final notes — no customer impact escalations, auto-resolved, root cause likely transient queue pressure on a single shard, follow-up ticket created ENGOPS-312 with first-pass action items. thanks :thumbsup:
mike: thanks jamie — will monitor and implement noise tuning tomorrow.
